description_zh: 皮卡（ego）在停止标志路口右转，拖车尾部碰到停在交叉口内的一辆静止车辆（v1，原 Waymo AV），测 ego 转弯路径是否考虑拖车甩尾空间。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling north on Genebern Way in autonomous mode when it came to a stop at a stop sign to prepare to make a left turn onto westbound Murray Street.

Immediately after, a pickup truck (hauling a gooseneck trailer carrying a shipping container) that had been traveling east on Murray Street came to a stop at a stop sign at the intersection with Genebern Way.

While the pickup truck remained stopped, the Waymo AV proceeded through the intersection. As the Waymo AV was making a left turn through the intersection, the pickup truck entered the intersection to make a right turn onto southbound Genebern Way.
After the Waymo AV partially entered westbound Murray Street, it came to a stop to yield to the pickup truck.
A moment later, while the Waymo AV remained stopped, the rear left corner of the shipping container made contact with the front driver side of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 选择主动右转的皮卡作为 ego，NPC 为停在路口内的静止车辆，位置 cross（左侧），行为 static_hold，控制信号为 stop_sign，可表达。
